description: Query inference request logs for a dedicated deployment over a time window. DeepInfra REST: GET /v1/logs/query.

deploy_id.description: The deployment id to query logs for (required).

from.description: Window start — fractional-seconds unix timestamp, inclusive.

limit.description: Max log lines to return (default 100, range 1..1000).

to.description: Window end — fractional-seconds unix timestamp, exclusive.

name: deepinfra_query_logs
title: Query logs
